extraction_notes: Identity verified: the supplied PDF visibly identifies 2SC2383, an NPN transistor in an SOT-89 package, with Rev:1.1. The PDF footer names Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd.; the exact manifest manufacturer token is hongjiacheng.
All three PDF pages were examined. Electrical characteristics and maximum ratings are on p. 1; Fig. 1 through Fig. 4 are on p. 2; Fig. 5 and Fig. 6 are on p. 3.

The electrical table gives hFE(1) = 60 minimum and 320 maximum at IC = 200 mA, VCE = 5.0 V, and hFE(2) = 40 minimum at IC = 10 mA, VCE = 5.0 V. The classification table gives rank ranges R = 60-120, O = 100-200, and Y = 160-320; no rank was inferred for the exact part.

The VCE(sat) table value is a guaranteed maximum of 1.0 V at IC = 500 mA and IB = 50 mA. The separate Base-Emitter Saturation Voltage row is a maximum of 0.75 V at IC = 5.0 mA and VCE = 5.0 V, and does not provide IB or the same IC/IB pair, so vbe_sat is null in the structured saturation point.

The fT table value is typical 20 MHz at IC = 200 mA and VCE = 5.0 V. No numeric Cobo or Cibo table values are supplied; the structured capacitance values are digitized typical read-offs from Fig. 6 at stated reverse biases.

Curve points are manual direct read-offs at visible axis positions from the supplied plots. Points are represented in SI units and were not interpolated between sampled positions. Guaranteed table minimums and maximums were not converted into typical values.

Maximum ratings additionally give VCBO = 160 V, VCEO = 160 V, VEBO = 6.0 V, continuous IC = 1.0 A, PC = 500 mW, Tj = -55 to +150 degC, Tstg = -55 to +150 degC, and typical RthetaJ-A = 250 degC/W. The strict BJT extraction schema has no fields for these additional limits beyond vceo.
